coming-soon.title: Soukly account area, coming soon
coming-soon.text: Sign-up, login and profile are coming here soon.

displayName.length: The name must be 2 to 50 characters long.

email.invalid: Invalid email address, for example name@example.tn.
email.unchanged: This is already the address of your account.

password.length: The password must be 8 to 128 characters long.
password.too-common: This password is too common. Choose another one.
password.same-as-email: The password must not be your email address.

terms.required: Accept the terms to create your account.

errors.too-many-requests: Too many requests in a short time. Wait a moment, then try again.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Check your connection, then try again.
errors.too-many-attempts: Too many attempts, please try again in a few minutes.

preferredLanguage.required: Choose the language of the emails.
preferredLanguage.invalid: Choose the language of the emails.

delete.understood: Tick the box to confirm the deletion.

register.title: Create an account
register.subtitle: Free, and it only takes a minute.

check-email.title: Check your email
check-email.sent-to: We sent an activation link to
check-email.validity: Click it to activate your account. The link is valid for 24 hours.
check-email.spam: Nothing received? Look in your spam folder.
check-email.no-address: Open the link we emailed you to activate your account. It is valid for 24 hours.

resend.sent: Email sent again. Remember to check your spam folder.

verify.activated-text: You can now log in and post your ads.
verify.invalid-title: This link is no longer valid
verify.invalid-text: It may have expired or already been used. Enter your email address to get a new link.
verify.resend-sent: If an account with this address is waiting for activation, a new link has just been sent to it.
verify.error-title: The link cannot be checked right now

login.title: Log in
login.subtitle: Welcome back to Soukly.
login.email-not-verified: Your email address is not verified yet. Open the link we emailed you, or ask for a new one.
login.throttled-seconds: Too many attempts. Try again in {{count}} s.
login.throttled-minutes: Too many attempts. Try again in {{count}} min.

welcome.title: One ad, posted everywhere
welcome.text: Link your Facebook Page and your Instagram account. For each ad, you choose whether to share it automatically or not.
welcome.note: You can link or remove your networks at any time from your profile. Soukly never posts without your consent.

listings.title: My listings
listings.expired-note: A listing put back online stays visible for 60 more days.
listings.error: Your listings could not be loaded. Check your connection.
listings.more-error: The next listings could not be loaded.

delete.title: Delete this listing?
delete.tip: Just sold or taking a break? Deactivate it instead: you can put it back online later.

toasts.link-failed: The link could not be copied.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.text: Enter the email of your account. We will send you a link to choose a new password.

forgot-sent.title: Check your email
forgot-sent.text-after: , you will receive a link to choose a new password. It is valid for 1 hour.
forgot-sent.no-address: If an account exists for this address, you will receive a link to choose a new password. It is valid for 1 hour.
forgot-sent.resent: Link sent again. Remember to check your spam folder.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.other-devices: You will be signed out of your other devices, then signed in right here.
reset.password-hint: At least 8 characters. Avoid common passwords.
reset.signed-in: Password changed. You are signed in.

invalid-link.title: This link is no longer valid
invalid-link.text: It has expired, has already been used, or a newer link was sent. Ask for a new one: it will be valid for 1 hour.

profile.title: My profile
profile.load-error: Your profile could not be loaded. Check your connection.

info.title: My details
info.phone-hint: Shown to signed-in members on all your listings.
info.email-language-hint: The site keeps the language of its address.

email-change.title: Change email
email-change.sent-after: , valid for 24 hours. Until then, you still sign in with the current one.
email-change.notice-sent: Your current address received a notice.

password-change.title: Change password
password-change.other-devices: Your other devices will be signed out. This one stays signed in.
password-change.changed: Password changed. Your other devices are signed out.

delete.title: Delete my account

listings.zero: you have no listing at the moment;
listings.one: your listing disappears from the site at once;
listings.two: your {{ count }} listings disappear from the site at once;
listings.few: your {{ count }} listings disappear from the site at once;
listings.many: your {{ count }} listings disappear from the site at once;
listings.other: your {{ count }} listings disappear from the site at once;

consequences.listings-unknown: all your listings disappear from the site at once;
consequences.sessions: you are signed out of all your devices;
consequences.purge: your data and photos are erased within 30 days;
consequences.networks: the posts Soukly made on your Facebook Page or Instagram are removed as far as possible.

delete.understood: I understand that my account and my listings will be deleted for good.

confirm-email.confirmed-text: From now on, sign in with this address. Your Soukly emails will go there.
confirm-email.taken-title: This address is already in use
confirm-email.taken-text: Another account has used this address since your request. Your address has not changed.
confirm-email.error-title: The link cannot be checked right now
confirm-email.invalid-text: It expired (24 hours), was already used, or a newer request replaced it. Make the request again from your profile.
